goal: Find a 2D ferromagnetic semiconductor with with direct bandgap > 1 eV.
Identify a transition-metal dichalcogenide with a direct bandgap > 1.5 eV at the K point and at least one candidate verified by DFT.
Find a 2D material with strong magnon-phonon coupling and a direct bandgap. If none of the standard CrX3 family works, suggest a substitution.

Find earth-abundant oxide semiconductors usable as the channel layer of a transparent flexible thin-film transistor, avoiding toxic and rare elements. Candidates must be non-magnetic, SCF-converged, have an experimental optical gap between 3.0 and 4.0 eV (wide enough for visible transparency, narrow enough to remain dopable rather than a dielectric), and be supported by at least one retrieved paper reporting synthesis and optoelectronic characterization.
_note: SET target_count: number of candidates you would accept as genuinely qualified. Regression companion to ox3 - materials passing ox3 must fail this.

goal: Identify an earth-abundant p-type transparent conducting oxide with an experimental optical gap above 3.0 eV and evidence of hole conduction. Report honestly if the corpus does not support any candidate.
_note: SET target_count, plausibly 0. Deliberately hard - p-type TCOs are rare and the corpus may hold nothing. Tests that the Critic returns 0 qualified rather than inventing support.

goal: Find an earth-abundant, non-toxic wide-gap oxide suitable as a gate dielectric for flexible electronics: non-magnetic, SCF-converged, experimental gap above 6 eV, with literature evidence of thin-film deposition.
_note: SET target_count. Inverse of ox1: Al2O3/SiO2/MgO should qualify here and fail ox1. If a material passes both, the gap window is not being enforced.
